description: Java class IncomingRequestPhoneService extending WearableListenerService, handling incoming messages from wear devices, managing permissions, and retrieving external storage info.

classes.name: IncomingRequestPhoneService
classes.description: Service handling incoming wear device requests for phone data and permissions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service and logs creation.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Processes incoming messages, distinguishes request types, and triggers permission prompts or data responses.

methods.name: promptUserForStoragePermission
methods.description: Checks storage permission; if granted, responds; if not, launches permission request activity.

methods.name: respondWithStorageInformation
methods.description: Checks permission; if granted, retrieves and sends directory listing; if not, requests permission.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a specified node using GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: isExternalStorageReadable
methods.description: Checks if external storage is mounted and readable.
